title: AI firms warn of risks. Why are they racing ahead? | Google DeepMind’s Lila Ibrahim
description: As artificial intelligence advances rapidly, leading AI firms are warning about potential risks while continuing to develop increasingly powerful systems. In this conversation, Google DeepMind’s Lila Ibrahim explores why the AI race is accelerating, the pressures driving innovation and the challenges of balancing progress with responsibility. The discussion examines AI safety, industry competition, governance and the importance of building technology that benefits society.
